subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept leader-verified direct-PID fallback as the new default for omitted `detached` Unix process cleanup after the branch is rebased?
rationale: The code shape appears correct, but the default cleanup behavior is compatibility-sensitive and GitHub reports the current head as conflicting, so automation should not treat this as a routine clean merge.

options.title: Refresh And Land Guarded Cleanup
options.body: Resolve the current conflict, rerun focused process cleanup and CI proof, then land the helper-side leader-check approach if the compatibility tradeoff is accepted.

options.title: Require More Caller State
options.body: Ask for additional audited callers to pass explicit detached state before merge if maintainers do not want omitted callers to rely on runtime leader detection.

options.title: Pause For Replacement
options.body: Close or pause this branch only if maintainers prefer a narrower replacement PR after rebase proves too risky.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Land Guarded Cleanup
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflict, rerun focused process cleanup and CI proof, then land the helper-side leader-check approach if the compatibility tradeoff is accepted.
